投資計畫的功能實際用了之後有兩個缺點:\
1.計畫跟警報沒有連動。通常計畫應該跟該股票的點數息息相關，例如低於幾點或高於幾點就要如何如何，所以計畫跟警報連動會讓這個功能更實用\
2.目前計畫只是按日期建立，但很多時候，一天中建的計畫常常都是筆記性質。真的要執行的時候看不出哪個計畫成功的機率比較，哪一個計劃執行的優先順序比較優先，或是計畫是否已執行\
針對上面兩個缺點，你有什麼優化建議

    79→    items_q = items_q.offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)
    80→    items = session.exec(items_q).all()

   199→          </div>
   200→          <div class="view-row">
   201→            <span class="view-label">計畫名稱</span>
   202→            <span class="view-val">{{ viewTarget.plan_name }}</span>
   203→          </div>
   204→          <div class="view-row">
   205→            <span class="view-label">投資人</span>
   206→            <span class="view-val">{{ viewTarget.investor || '—' }}</span>
   207→          </div>
   208→          <div class="view-row">
   209→            <span class="view-label">股票代號</span>
   210→            <span class="view-val">{{ viewTarget.ticker || '—' }}</span>
   211→          </div>
   212→          <div class="view-row">
   213→            <span class="view-label">股票名稱</span>
   214→            <span class="view-val">{{ viewTarget.stock_name || '—' }}</span>
   215→          </div>
   216→          <div class="view-row">
   217→            <span class="view-label">計畫內容</span>
   218→            <span class="view-val view-content">{{ viewTarget.content }}</span>
   219→          </div>
   220→        </div>
   221→        <div class="modal-footer">
   222→          <button class="modal-cancel" @click="viewTarget = null">關閉</button>
   223→        </div>
   224→      </div>
   225→    </div>
   226→
   227→    <!-- Delete Confirmation Modal -->
   228→    <div v-if="deleteTarget" class="modal-overlay" @click.self="deleteTarget = null">
   229→      <div class="modal">
   230→        <h3>確認刪除</h3>
   231→        <p>確定要刪除 <strong>{{ deleteTarget.plan_name }}</strong> 這筆投資計畫嗎？</p>
   232→        <div class="modal-footer">
   233→          <button class="modal-cancel" @click="deleteTarget = null">取消</button>
   234→          <button class="modal-confirm" @click="doDelete">確認刪除</button>
   235→        </div>
   236→      </div>
   237→    </div>
   238→  </div>
   239→</template>
   240→
   241→<script setup lang="ts">
   242→import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue'
   243→import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
   244→import { useAuthStore } from '@/stores/auth'
   245→import client from '@/api/client'
   246→
   247→const router = useRouter()
   248→const auth = useAuthStore()
   249→
   250→const plans = ref<any[]>([])
   251→const total = ref(0)
   252→const loading = ref(false)
   253→const prices = ref<Record<string, any>>({})
   254→
   255→const currentPage = ref(1)
   256→const pageSize = ref(10)
   257→
   258→const searchDate = ref('')
   259→const searchStock = ref('')
   260→const searchInvestor = ref('')
   261→const appliedDate = ref('')
   262→const appliedStock = ref('')
   263→const appliedInvestor = ref('')
   264→
   265→const showForm = ref(false)
   266→const editingPlan = ref<any>(null)
   267→const submitting = ref(false)
   268→const formError = ref('')
   269→const form = ref({
   270→  plan_date: '',
   271→  plan_name: '',
   272→  investor: '',
   273→  ticker: '',
   274→  stock_name: '',
   275→  content: '',
   276→})
   277→
   278→const deleteTarget = ref<any>(null)
   279→const viewTarget = ref<any>(null)
   280→
   281→const totalPages = computed(() => Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total.value / pageSize.value)))
   282→
   283→const visiblePages = computed(() => {
   284→  const result: number[] = []
   285→  const tp = totalPages.value
   286→  const cur = currentPage.value
   287→  let start = Math.max(1, cur - 2)
   288→  const end = Math.min(tp, start + 4)
   289→  if (end - start < 4) start = Math.max(1, end - 4)
   290→  for (let i = start; i <= end; i++) result.push(i)
   291→  return result
   292→})
   293→
   294→async function loadPlans() {
   295→  loading.value = true
   296→  const startTs = Date.now()
   297→  try {
   298→    const params: Record<string, any> = { page: currentPage.value, page_size: pageSize.value }
   299→    if (appliedDate.value) params.plan_date = appliedDate.value
   300→    if (appliedStock.value) params.stock = appliedStock.value
   301→    if (appliedInvestor.value) params.investor = appliedInvestor.value
   302→
   303→    const res = await client.get('/investment-plans', { params })
   304→    plans.value = res.data.items
   305→    total.value = res.data.total
   306→    fetchPrices()
   307→  } finally {
   308→    const elapsed = Date.now() - startTs
   309→    if (400 - elapsed > 0) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400 - elapsed))
   310→    loading.value = false
   311→  }
   312→}
   313→
   314→async function fetchPrices() {
   315→  const tickers = [...new Set<string>(plans.value.map((p: any) => p.ticker))]
   316→  tickers.forEach(t => {
   317→    if (!(t in prices.value)) prices.value[t] = undefined
   318→  })
   319→  await Promise.allSettled(
   320→    tickers.map(async (ticker) => {
   321→      try {
   322→        const res = await client.get(`/stocks/${ticker}/price`)
   323→        prices.value = { ...prices.value, [ticker]: res.data }
   324→      } catch {
   325→        prices.value = { ...prices.value, [ticker]: null }
   326→      }
   327→    })
   328→  )
   329→}
   330→
   331→function doSearch() {
   332→  appliedDate.value = searchDate.value
   333→  appliedStock.value = searchStock.value
   334→  appliedInvestor.value = searchInvestor.value
   335→  currentPage.value = 1
   336→  loadPlans()
   337→}
   338→
   339→function clearField(field: 'date' | 'stock' | 'investor') {
   340→  if (field === 'date') searchDate.value = ''
   341→  if (field === 'stock') searchStock.value = ''
   342→  if (field === 'investor') searchInvestor.value = ''
   343→  doSearch()
   344→}
   345→
   346→function gotoPage(p: number) {
   347→  if (p < 1 || p > totalPages.value) return
   348→  currentPage.value = p
   349→  loadPlans()
   350→}
   351→
   352→function onPageSizeChange() {
   353→  currentPage.value = 1
   354→  loadPlans()
   355→}
   356→
   357→function openCreate() {
   358→  editingPlan.value = null
   359→  form.value = { plan_date: '', plan_name: '', investor: '', ticker: '', stock_name: '', content: '' }
   360→  formError.value = ''
   361→  showForm.value = true
   362→}
   363→
   364→function openEdit(plan: any) {
   365→  editingPlan.value = plan
   366→  form.value = {
   367→    plan_date: plan.plan_date,
   368→    plan_name: plan.plan_name,
   369→    investor: plan.investor,
   370→    ticker: plan.ticker,
   371→    stock_name: plan.stock_name,
   372→    content: plan.content,
   373→  }
   374→  formError.value = ''
   375→  showForm.value = true
   376→}
   377→
   378→async function submitForm() {
   379→  if (!form.value.plan_date || !form.value.plan_name || !form.value.content) {
   380→    formError.value = '請填寫所有必填欄位（*）'
   381→    return
   382→  }
   383→  submitting.value = true
   384→  formError.value = ''
   385→  try {
   386→    if (editingPlan.value) {
   387→      await client.put(`/investment-plans/${editingPlan.value.id}`, form.value)
   388→    } else {
   389→      await client.post('/investment-plans', form.value)
   390→    }
   391→    showForm.value = false
   392→    await loadPlans()
   393→  } catch (e: any) {
   394→    formError.value = e.response?.data?.detail || '操作失敗，請重試'
   395→  } finally {
   396→    submitting.value = false
   397→  }
   398→}
   399→
   400→async function doDelete() {
   401→  if (!deleteTarget.value) return
   402→  await client.delete(`/investment-plans/${deleteTarget.value.id}`)
   403→  deleteTarget.value = null
   404→  await loadPlans()
   405→}
   406→
   407→function logout() {
   408→  auth.logout()
   409→  router.push('/login')
   410→}
   411→
   412→onMounted(loadPlans)
   413→</script>

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-4-6 2026-08-18 14:48:14Z)**_

好問題。數字優先序的問題是「沒有明確定義」，每個人對 3 分的理解不同，時間久了標準就會飄移。以下幾個替代方案：

---

## 方案一：語意化標籤（最推薦）

用文字取代數字，意義明確、不需思考：

| 標籤 | 說明 |
|------|------|
| 🔴 **立即執行** | 條件已成熟，今天就要動作 |
| 🟡 **等待時機** | 方向確定，等觸發條件 |
| 🔵 **持續觀察** | 還在評估，尚未決定 |
| ⚪ **備用筆記** | 僅記錄想法，不打算近期行動 |

優點：打開計畫一眼知道哪些要馬上看、不需要解釋「3分是什麼意思」

---

## 方案二：看板式狀態欄（與缺點二合併）

把「優先序」跟「狀態」合併成一欄，減少欄位數量：

```
草稿 → 等待觸發 → 執行中 → 已完成/放棄
```

流程本身就隱含了優先序——執行中的計畫自然排在最前面。

---

## 方案三：固定三色旗標（最簡單）

只有三個選項，類似 email 星號標記：

- 🚩 **紅旗**：重要且急
- 📌 **釘選**：重要不急
- 無標記：一般筆記

---

## 我的建議

**方案一（語意標籤）+ 方案二（狀態流）合併使用**：

- `狀態`（草稿 / 等待觸發 / 執行中 / 已完成 / 放棄）解決「計畫到哪了」
- `緊急度`（立即 / 等待 / 觀察）解決「我現在要看哪個」

兩欄搭配，搜尋時可以快速過濾「緊急 + 等待觸發」的計畫，就是最需要關注的清單。

---

要實作的話，你比較偏好哪個方向？
